digest.component_or_area: Gerrit CI gate steps in GitHub Actions workflow
propositions: New gate steps run workflow definitions from target branch but check out the change's tree, causing hard failures when the script does not exist in the checked-out tree.
Pre-gate changes whose base predates the gate-introducing commit fail verification because the gate script is absent from their checked-out tree.
Gate steps must guard script invocations with existence checks (if [ -f script ]) to skip gracefully when the script is not present in the checked-out tree.
The documented idiom and copy-me pattern must be included inline in the workflow to prevent future gate-script landings from re-opening the failure window.
